specs.name: Hot-add `median` to a live SensorWindow class
specs.final_source:
inherit(Object, #SensorWindow, #(#vals), 1, nil)!!

now(SensorWindow)!!

Def init(self | w) { w := new(OrderedCollection); self.vals := w; ^self; }!!

Def record(self, v) { add(self.vals, v); ^self; }!!

Def readingCount(self) { ^size(self.vals); }!!

Def valueAt(self, i) { ^self.vals[i]; }!!

Def median(self | n sorted i j mid a b) { n := size(self.vals); if (n == 0) then ^nil; endif; sorted := new(OrderedCollection); i := 0; loop while (i < n) begin add(sorted, self.vals[i]); i := i + 1; endLoop; i := 1; loop while (i < n) begin j := i; loop while ((j > 0) & (sorted[j - 1] > sorted[j])) begin a := sorted[j]; sorted[j] := sorted[j - 1]; sorted[j - 1] := a; j := j - 1; endLoop; i := i + 1; endLoop; mid := n / 2; if ((n % 2) == 1) then ^sorted[mid]; else a := sorted[mid - 1]; b := sorted[mid]; ^((a + b) / 2); endif; }!!

specs.name: Stateful closed/open/half-open retry guard

now(CircuitBreaker)!!

Def initBreaker(self, failThreshold, cooldownTicks) { self.state := #closed; self.failThreshold := failThreshold; self.cooldownTicks := cooldownTicks; self.failureCount := 0; self.tripCount := 0; self.openedAt := 0; self.probeOutstanding := false; ^self; }!!

Def state(self) { ^self.state; }!!

Def failureCount(self) { ^self.failureCount; }!!

Def tripCount(self) { ^self.tripCount; }!!
